versions.name: Canoeing
versions.description: Paddle tandem well enough to pivot, move sideways, and hold a straight line, then handle the hard parts: a controlled capsize, reentry in deep water, emptying a swamped canoe, and a throw-bag rescue.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
